correctness.rationale: For q=r²=e^-L the Laurent monomial norms give H(t)=πtK=1/L+∑_{n≠0}n t^n/(1-q^n). On the negative axis t=-e^-Lv, Poisson summation of g(y)=1/(4cosh²(y/2)), with Fourier transform πω/sinh(πω), yields exactly H=-4π²/L²∑_{k≥1} k cos(2πkv)/sinh(2π²k/L). With E=e^-2π²/L, at v=1/4 the first nonzero even harmonic gives H=16π² E²/L² (1+O(E²)), while H_v=16π³ E/L²(1+O(E²)); uniform first-harmonic domination in an O(E) neighborhood places the outer root at v=1/4-E/π+o(E). Then Δ=2e^-L/4 sinh(L(1/4-v)) ~ (2L/π)e^-L/4 E = (4sqrt(r)/π)log(1/r) exp(-π²/log(1/r)). Verified direct logistic-series/Poisson duality numerically at multiple L with high precision, checking the prefactor. Gustafsson–Sebbar Theorem 6.1 is used explicitly, not re-proved, for the exact full zero-free band identification.
